# Literal fallbacks that are still open, as `<relpath>:<line>:<pattern-id>`.
#
# Each line is a place where an original-household literal still wins when the
# configuration field is empty. These are the remaining members of the LL-01 family
# recorded in .dev/SecurityAudit.html section 3.
#
# This list can only SHRINK:
#   * a hit that is not listed fails `test_no_new_literal_fallback__has_been_introduced`
#   * a listed line that stops matching fails `test_fallback_allowlist__has_no_stale_entries`
#
# So when a fix lands, the suite tells you to delete the line, and deleting it locks the
# fix in. Line numbers move when a file is edited; refresh with:
#
#   PYTHONPATH=Scripts python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'Scripts');\
#   from tests.support import env,scans;print('\n'.join(sorted(scans.scan_fallbacks(env.app_checkout_dir()))))"
#
